```{r}
suppress_all_output <- function(expr) {
  temp_file <- tempfile()
  con <- file(temp_file, open = "wt")

  # Redirect stdout and messages
  sink(con)
  sink(con, type = "message")

  # Suppress warnings and messages globally
  old_warn <- getOption("warn")
  options(warn = -1)

  # Evaluate expression quietly
  result <- suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages(
      tryCatch(
        eval(expr),
        error = function(e) NULL  # suppress error output
      )
    )
  )

  # Restore options and sinks
  options(warn = old_warn)
  sink(NULL)
  sink(NULL, type = "message")
  close(con)

  invisible(result)
}

```

```{r}
format.rq.svy <- function(x, rdf) {
  V <- attr(x, "var")
  FLAG <- length(V) == 1
  se <- if (FLAG) sqrt(V) else sqrt(diag(V))
  val <- cbind(as.matrix(x), se, NA, NA)
  if (FLAG) val <- matrix(val, nrow=1)
  val[, 3] <- val[, 1]/val[, 2]
  val[, 4] <- 2*(1 - pt(abs(val[, 3]), rdf))
  colnames(val) <- c("Value", "Std_Error", "T_value", "P_Value")
  rownames(val) <- names(x)
  return(val)
}

```


* https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/650071/quantile-regression-with-sampling-weights-in-r
```{r}
Quantile_Reg <- function(exp_var = NULL,
                         dataset,
                         my_outcome,
                         Reg_Type,
                         my_covariates,
                         design = dsn,
                         quantiles = c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)) {
  
  
  vars <- unique(c(my_outcome, exp_var, my_covariates))

  mydf_ua <- dataset %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ !is.na(.)))



  if (nrow(mydf_ua) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  rhs <- if (is.null(exp_var)) paste(my_covariates, collapse = "+") else exp_var
    #rhs <-  exp_var

  myform <- as.formula(paste(my_outcome, "~", rhs))

    # Convert to replicate weights if not already
    if (!inherits(design, "svrep.design")) {
      rep_design <- as.svrepdesign(design, type = "bootstrap", replicates = 50)
    }

    # ---- Replicate-weighted quantile regression ----
    # boot_rq <- function(w, dataset, tau) {
    #   dataset$.__w__ <- w
    #   fit <- rq(myform, tau = tau, data = dataset, weights = dataset$.__w__)
    #   setNames(coef(fit), names(coef(fit)))
    # }
    
    rq_results <- list()
    for (b in seq_along(quantiles)) {
      tau_i <- quantiles[b]
      #print(tau_i)
      fit <- withReplicates(rep_design, quote(coef(rq(as.formula(paste(my_outcome, "~", rhs)), 
                                                      tau = tau_i, data = dataset, weights = dataset$.__w__))))
      mydof <- nrow(mydf_ua) - 3
      out <- format.rq.svy(x = fit,rdf = mydof)
      out <- as.data.frame(out) %>% 
        mutate(Tau = tau_i) %>% 
        rownames_to_column("Variable")
      rq_results[[b]] <- out
    }

    ctable_final <- bind_rows(rq_results) %>%
      mutate(Outcome = my_outcome,
             Exposure = ifelse(is.null(exp_var), NA, exp_var))
    
    # ---- Predict quantiles using point weights ----
    main_weights <- weights(design)
    mydf_ua$.__w__ <- main_weights[as.numeric(rownames(mydf_ua))]

    rq_model_final <- rq(myform, tau = quantiles, data = mydf_ua, weights = mydf_ua$.__w__)
    predicted_quantiles <- predict(rq_model_final, newdata = mydf_ua)
    predicted_quantiles <- as.data.frame(predicted_quantiles)
    colnames(predicted_quantiles) <- paste0("Tau_", quantiles)

    Quantile_Results <- list(mydf_ua, predicted_quantiles)
    Final_Results <- list(Regression_Results = ctable_final,
                          Quantile_Results = Quantile_Results)
    return(Final_Results)
  
}

```



```{r}
ExWAS_Function_Metab <- function(Exposure_Data, myexposures,myoutcomes, Outcome_Data,mycovars,join_var,Reg_Type){
  
   all_pheno_unadjusted <- list()
  all_pheno_adjusted <- list()

  #Run Regression for all outcomes
for(j in seq_along(myoutcomes)){
  
  
   pheno <- myoutcomes[j]
  adjusted_results <- list()
  unadjusted_results <- list()
          
          if(is.null(myexposures)){
            loop_n <- "CovOnly"
          }else(
            loop_n = myexposures
          )
  
          for(i in seq_along(loop_n)){
          #print(i)
            my_covariates <- mycovars
            
            
            #curr_metab <- child_list_Targeted[[i]]
            # curr_pheno <- Child_Outcomes %>% 
            #   dplyr::select(Child_PID,all_of(pheno))

            
            curr_exposure <- Exposure_Data %>% 
              dplyr::select(join_var,myexposures[i],all_of(my_covariates)) %>% 
              #dplyr::filter(Study == "CEHC") %>% 
              distinct()
            
            curr_pheno <- Outcome_Data %>% 
              dplyr::select(join_var,all_of(pheno)) %>% 
              dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!sym(pheno)))
            
            curr_outcome_pheno <- left_join(curr_pheno,curr_exposure,by = c(join_var)) %>%
              mutate(!! pheno := as.numeric(!! rlang::sym(pheno))) %>%
              distinct(.keep_all = T)

            
            curr_exp <- myexposures[i]

            
  
#             in_silence(
# {

          Curr_Unadjusted_Results <- try(Quantile_Reg(exp_var = curr_exp,
                                  dataset = curr_outcome_pheno,
                                  my_outcome = pheno,
                                  Reg_Type = Reg_Type,
                                  my_covariates = my_covariates,
                                  design = dsn))
          
          unadjusted_results[[i]] <- Curr_Unadjusted_Results

          names(unadjusted_results)[i] <- curr_exp

#})
        }

  
  all_pheno_unadjusted[[j]] <- unadjusted_results

  names(all_pheno_unadjusted)[j] <- myoutcomes[j]

}


return(all_pheno_unadjusted)
  
  
}

```
